data.narrative:
Physical Intelligence, a Series B AI & Software company founded by Karol Hausman, Sergey Levine, Chelsea Finn, and Brian Ichter, is valued at $5.6B post-money following $600M+ in total fundraising. The valuation assessment draws on a peer universe of 9 comparable companies—1 public (Palantir) and 8 private firms including Figure AI, Reflection AI, Skild AI, Crusoe Energy, and Together AI, spanning Series A through Series C stages.

Two valuation methods triangulate a defensible range. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.9x multiplier typical of Series B to next-stage advancement, yielding $10.6B. Peer-median analysis across 7 same-sector and stage-adjacent comparables produces $10.0B, with the peer set ranging from $2.0B to $39.0B. The disparity reflects significant variance within the AI & Software frontier-tech cohort, particularly the elevated positions of Figure AI ($39.0B) and Reflection AI ($25.0B).

Triangulation of these two methods supports a valuation range of $8.5B (low) to $12.2B (high), with a median of $10.3B. This implies modest upside from the current $5.6B valuation. Key uncertainties center on comparable company trajectory—peer valuations in this sector have demonstrated high volatility—and Physical Intelligence's proprietary technology differentiation relative to a crowded frontier-AI landscape. Limited public market comparables further constrains precision.
